statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. A weak JOLTS and consumer-confidence cluster printed at 14:00 UTC and was absorbed with a genuine retracement: cash NDX fell from 30,429.97 to a 30,270.04 low beneath its prior close, then recovered to 30,328.75, while NQ holds 30,638.00, up 0.23%. VIX is easing to 15.84 and the retracement behaviour that mean reversion depends on is intact.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold, so the mapped state is WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. No narrow danger window is flagged for the remainder of the September 29 US session, which carries no further scheduled high-impact release. The flagged window covers 12:00 to 14:00 UTC on September 30, spanning the 12:15 UTC ADP employment change, the 12:30 UTC block of August core PCE, personal spending, final Q2 GDP and the advance goods trade balance, and the delayed second leg into the 13:30 UTC cash open and 13:45 UTC Chicago PMI; the published forecast maps those two hours to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Outside that window the forecast holds the watch band and reaches the low band through the US evening and Asian overnight hours. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this mapping.
headline: NQ holds 30,638.00, up 0.23%, as a 6.7-point drop in consumer confidence to 81.9 and a 7.079M JOLTS miss are absorbed with a real retracement; VIX eases to 15.84 while the 10-year presses 5.26%
body: NQ front-month trades 30,638.00, up 71.75 points or 0.23% against a 30,566.25 prior close, on a quote timestamped 15:02 UTC. The session opened at 30,560.50, fell to 30,372.25, rallied to a 30,725.50 high and has since given back roughly 88 points, so both extremes have been visited and each leg drew a meaningful retracement. The cash Nasdaq-100 is the clearer evidence: it opened at 30,412.29, reached 30,429.97, then fell through its 30,276.81 prior close to a 30,270.04 low after the 14:00 UTC data block, and has recovered about 59 points to 30,328.75, up 0.17%. That is a completed two-way response to a downside surprise rather than a failed retracement. The data itself was weak. The Conference Board consumer confidence index fell 6.7 points to 81.9 against a 89.2 consensus and an 88.6 prior, its lowest reading since 2014, with the expectations index down to 63.6 in a third consecutive monthly decline and net views on business conditions negative for the first time since September 2024. BLS reported August job openings little changed at 7.079 million against a 7.23 million consensus and a 7.335 million prior, with quits at 3.066 million. The Dallas Fed services index printed -1.8 against a consensus near 1. Implied volatility did not respond: VIX trades 15.84, down 1.43% from a 16.07 close, inside a 15.73 to 16.19 range and near the session low. The genuine amplifier is duration. The ten-year trades 5.26%, up two basis points and near its 5.27% session high after Monday's 5.234% close, the highest since June 2007, while CME FedWatch put October hike odds near 70%. Crude has eased, with WTI down 1.08% to 91.60 and Brent down 0.76% to 104.48 as United States and Iran mediation continues. The AI complex remains the main single-name risk after OpenAI paused frontier-model training pending further safeguards and reports of an Anthropic IPO prospectus circulated, and an early chip-led opening bid faded through the morning. The shared Finviz context file was collected at 14:22 UTC, within the 90-minute freshness limit, and was used as supporting cross-asset context only: its collection status is partial with the futures and calendar sections unavailable, and its breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections are labelled latest-session and non-real-time. Those sections show a genuine internal divergence, with all seven tracked semiconductors positive and a mean change near 1.9% against only three of eight megacaps positive and Apple and Alphabet lower, which reduces directional conviction and supports elevated Stress rather than Tail. All price, yield, volatility and release evidence above comes from independent current research. The net picture is high but decaying Stress, a live duration amplifier, and no observed persistent one-way structure, which holds Tail at the watch-band floor.

lookbackSummary: Twenty-three of the 24 preceding hours were published; the 14:00 UTC slot is unavailable because no Claude assessment was published in that clock hour. Tail ranged from 17 to 24 across the available hours and never reached the elevated band. Tail troughed at 17 through the late Monday and early Tuesday overnight session, printed 24 at 01:00, 03:00 and 04:00 UTC during the European handover as the duration selloff was repriced, then held 20 to 21 in each of the last nine available hours. Stress declined steadily from 84 to 74 as implied volatility decayed from Monday's selloff. Confidence held between 86 and 88 throughout. The dominant mode was mixed for 14 hours, normal for four in the quiet US evening, trend-down for four around the overnight duration stress, and trend-up for one hour as NQ pressed its session high.
outlookSummary: The published forecast keeps Tail in the watch band through the remainder of the September 29 US session, easing to the low band in the early afternoon lull and again through the US evening and Asian overnight window, which is the pattern the lookback recorded a day earlier. Tail returns to the watch band across the European handover and cash session on September 30 and builds gradually as positioning for the release block develops. The horizon contains one narrow elevated-band window of two hours: 12:00 UTC on September 30, covering the 12:15 UTC ADP employment change and the 12:30 UTC block of August core PCE, personal spending, final Q2 GDP and the advance goods trade balance, and 13:00 UTC, covering the delayed second leg into the 13:30 UTC cash open and the 13:45 UTC Chicago PMI. Stress is forecast to decay from 75 to 68 overnight before rebuilding to 79 into the release block, and Confidence steps down from 88 to 76 across the horizon as the current price-path evidence ages. Every hour beyond the current clock hour describes a conditional path rather than observed structure.
